== frame command_after_pipe cursor=2,36
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ set PATH $HOME/bin
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo hi | upcase
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 set
@2 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@2 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
== frame file_after_redirect cursor=2,37
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ set PATH $HOME/bin
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo hi > out.txt
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 set
@2 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@2 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
